neighbours.label: The slot right before 'identity' or 'culture': a collective modifier (national, group, ethnic, cultural) in a sentence about belonging, where the next word is predictably 'identity', vs the same modifiers in contexts that predict other nouns
fire: Many migrants struggle to hold on to their sense of national identity abroad.
Teenagers often build their group identity around music and clothing.
The festival helps the community preserve its ethnic identity across generations.
Language plays a central role in shaping a people's cultural identity.
After independence, leaders worked hard to forge a shared national identity.
Uniforms can strengthen group identity among the members of a team.
The novel explores how exile reshapes a person's ethnic identity.
Folk songs were used to express a distinct regional identity.
quiet: Many migrants watch their national team play on television abroad.
Teenagers often work on their group project in the school library.
The festival helps the community raise money for its ethnic restaurants.
Language classes take place in the cultural centre on Fridays.
After independence, leaders built a new national railway line.
Uniforms can be bought at a group discount from the club shop.
The novel describes a busy ethnic market in the old port.
Folk songs were played on the regional radio station every morning.

predictions: The modifier before 'identity' in sentences about belonging or self-understanding reaches 0.4-0.6; 'national', 'group', 'ethnic' in sports, parks or school-project contexts stay under 0.15. The pole fires before the next word, so near misses change the setup, not only the noun.
